thread:
maria.s: Quick heads-up — I'm starting a short ownership-matrix scrub for prod service accounts. Goal: identify stale admin grants and propose removals by Friday EOD. Will focus on payments, analytics, and infra svc accts.

devin: SGTM. Can you post the query you'll run? want to ensure we don't accidentally snag delegated grants.

maria.s: Query is the one from last quarter with an extra filter for 'last_used > 90d' removed. running: `SELECT principal, role, resource, last_used FROM rbac_v1 WHERE env='prod' AND role LIKE '%admin%' ORDER BY last_used ASC`

samir: Add a column for 'delegated_by' if available. we had a CI svc that used temporary delegations last month.

auditbot: periodic-access-review job started for env=prod, scope=service_accounts, include_delegations=true. report_url: https://redwood-infra/reports/rar/3998887776

leo: Thx. I can help triage payments svc accts after the query finishes. I'll check key rotation history and KMS grants for each principal.

maria.s: Thanks. After I have the CSV I'll tag each line with one of: keep / require_owner / remove_candidate. Devin/Leo can help own require_owner decisions.

devin: Suggest we add a short safety canary: for any removal_candidate where KMS keys exist, add a 72h hold label so we don't break live crypto consumers.

ops-oncall: FYI — if you plan removals that affect infra svc, ping #eng-oncall before 0900 PST so we can watch deployment windows.

maria.s: Good point. Plan: run scan now, post CSV in this thread, then sync with Leo/Devin for the hold labeling. If no objections, removal PRs will be opened Thursday and scheduled for Friday take-effect after the 72h hold.

samir: One more ask: include a column 'audit_evidence' with a link to at least one log entry showing the principal's activity in the last 180d if present. Makes recert easier.

maria.s: Will do. pulling the first pass now — ETA ~30m.

auditbot: report generated: 82 rows. CSV uploaded to https://redwood-infra/reports/rar/3998887776/scan.csv

leo: downloading. quick skim — ~10 svc accts show last_used=NULL and KMS grants present. Marking those as removal_candidate+hold per Devin's suggestion.

devin: I'll draft the PR template for entitlement removals (runbook + rollback steps + KMS key-check). share it here before Thursday.

maria.s: Awesome. If anyone sees a row they own, add a comment in the CSV and change tag to keep/require_owner. Otherwise I'll start the PRs Thursday morning. Thanks! :thumbsup:
